capabilities.name: L1 Foundation Freeze
capabilities.description: The L1 foundation substrate is frozen green: single-physical-CRDB logical database isolation topology (zen_identity, zen_fabric, zen_platform authorities; zen_trust defined but not composed), external 443-only network contract with port-forward/nodePort/hostPort/TLS-bypass forbidden, mode A and mode B enrollment with restart-safe mTLS, HA failover, negative matrix, network policy, external-443 proof, cleanup, and verdict-integrity negative controls. Three repeated qualification runs, all pass, zero manual interventions (recorded 2026-08-31). Upper layers consume L1 as a dependable frozen contract under the monotonic layer rule.
evidence_refs: 3 repeated qualification runs, all PASS, durations under 20 minutes
validator_refs: zen-platform-v1 scripts/qualification/test_verdict_integrity.py (phase-exception, raised-exception, and cleanup-failure negative controls)

capabilities.name: L2 Connect Freeze
capabilities.description: The bounded Connect/L2 contract is frozen green: mode A and mode B continuity, HA failover with declared lease-derived bounds (lease 15s, renew deadline 10s, retry period 2s; rollout and observation bounds 300s) with split-brain not observed and re-enrollment or PVC deletion never used, restart matrix with disable/no-resurrection, the 24-block connect vertical, projection SQL evidence, CLI parity over canonical Control-family SPIFFE with no TLS bypass, network policy matrix, image digest law, control capability verification with tamper/wrong-key/stale-generation/digest-without-signature denial negatives, and placement bootstrap security (RLS tenant isolation, active-only bootstrap read, tenantless write denied, inactive allocation bootstrap denied). Four counted runs (baseline + repeat 1-3) across 51 gates, zero non-pass gates, zero manual interventions (recorded 2026-09-06).
evidence_refs: zen-mgmt releases/l2-connect-frozen-green.yaml (release binding of the freeze artifact)
4 counted runs: baseline + repeat 1-3, decision PASS, same candidate, zero manual interventions
validator_refs: zen-platform-v1 qualification gate summary (51 gates incl. mode_a, mode_b_pre_negative, mode_b_continuity, ha_failover, ha_fencing, restart_matrix, connect_vertical_24_blocks, projection_sql_evidence, cli_parity, netpol_matrix, image_digest_law, disable_no_resurrection)

capabilities.name: Traffic V1.1 Engine Freeze
capabilities.description: The declared frozen pre-cloud Traffic V1.1 engine candidate (artifact id traffic-99951a0d): successful ingress acknowledgement is emitted only after the declared durable acceptance boundary, with enumerated crash-window negative tests (crash before persist, crash after persist before enqueue, crash during dispatch, crash after target before commit, restart recovery); the HA contract prefers retryable refusal (503 with Retry-After) over false acceptance when required replay/durability authority is unavailable, and accepted loss is forbidden in counted qualification; cross-replica replay uses replicated nonce authority for correctness with gateway affinity as optimization only. Counted qualification: BASELINE + REPEAT 1-3 from main, all four runs all-green across the 8 declared scenarios (flow01_basic, two_tenant_isolation, reliability, outage_lkg, graceful_shutdown, flow01_ha, ssrf, acceptance_durability), failure matrix 24/24, manual_interventions = 0 (frozen 2026-09-06). Duplicate receipts remain possible under the declared duplicate-semantics bound.
evidence_refs: zen-platform-v1 traffic-qual/results/final-report.json (compiled counted report with candidate-mismatch exclusion audit)
zen-platform-v1 freeze commit TRAFFIC_V11_ENGINE_FROZEN_GREEN on main

capabilities.name: China Market Strategy
capabilities.description: China market strategy documentation and provider Pack planning: regional Traffic Plane architecture, the payload-locality architectural commitment, and provider Pack templates (Antom/Alipay and WeChat Pay in development; UnionPay planned). Regional deployed proof is not produced. This capability is documentation/design-stage evidence and is subordinate to the global V1.1 baseline; it does not define the baseline scope.

antom-alipay.scope: asynchronous payment notifications, signature verification, acknowledgement, retries, duplicate handling, active inquiry/reconciliation, private or regional delivery

wechat-pay.scope: payment-success callbacks, signature and encryption requirements, HTTPS endpoint posture, firewall/IP considerations, retries, duplicate notifications, idempotent processing

unionpay.scope: backend notification URL, asynchronous transaction results, signature verification, response deadline, retry behavior, reconciliation

capabilities.name: Payload Locality
capabilities.description: Customer event payloads are processed inside the regional Traffic Plane and are never proxied by the control plane. This is a hard architectural commitment, not a best-effort property and not weakened with qualifiers. Local/sandbox proof exists for the locality concepts; regional deployed proof is not produced.
non_claims: Regional deployed proof is not produced
Not a production-live locality enforcement claim
